name: Parser and serialization robustness
pre_registered_hypothesis: Improving constrained output / parser recovery increases benchmark performance without an entropy policy.
primary_metric: parse failure rate on gated prereq steps

name: Parser and serialization robustness
result_summary: 0/3276 gated primary steps raised or mis-parsed; all 1910 orphans are deliberate free-text no-calls (signature no_call). Parse failure rate ~0%: no headroom.

name: Selective write-rescue on no-call steps (refinement of #10 delayed commitment: same write/no-write commitment margin, opposite direction, per Stage 3 T2 evidence)
mechanism: 58% of gated prereq steps produce no write; exploration samples predict the choice at AUC 0.998; when the primary declines but sampled actions contain a modal write, committing it may rescue facts that never reach the store (the known score bottleneck).
pre_registered_hypothesis: Committing the modal sampled write on no-call prereq steps increases the number of questions whose gold facts are carried+retrievable in the final store, and downstream accuracy vs equal-budget random-select control.
primary_metric: offline: questions with uncarried gold rescued by modal orphan write; live: paired accuracy vs A1
development_data: gov_logs/hnav_shadow orphan records + final snapshots + gold index
decision: GO criterion: expected dAcc >= 0.02 x p_hat-adjusted on >=1 backend from modal-write rescue

name: Selective write-rescue on no-call steps
result_summary: Falsifier GO: modal sampled write rescues gold uncarried by final store: vector 9/9/9 questions (expected dAcc ~+0.035), kv 2/4/4 (+0.013-0.016). A2 fires on only 55/1910 no-call steps (2.9%) -- surgical, low pollution risk. Caveats: pseudo-replicated shadow draws; p_hat conversion optimistic (retrievability unchecked); live trajectories will diverge after committed writes.

name: Factorized operation/target/content uncertainty
pre_registered_hypothesis: Factorized uncertainty (H_op, H_target|op, H_args) predicts action failure better than a single entropy score.

name: Factorized operation/target/content uncertainty
result_summary: Falsified by the pre-registered Stage 3 ladder itself: per-resolution entropies (M5 op / M6 target / M7 full / M8 all) each add ~0 or negative dAUC over vote controls on T1 (dAUC_M8_vs_M4 = -0.013, CI [-0.037, +0.001]); univariate perm p 0.61-0.70, Holm 1.0. On T2 entropy adds +0.0000 beyond votes at any resolution. No factorization signal exists to exploit on this benchmark.
decision: dead: tested by pre-registered ladder, no incremental value at any resolution

name: Backend-specific uncertainty policies
pre_registered_hypothesis: Backend-specific calibration improves over a shared global policy.

name: Backend-specific uncertainty policies
result_summary: No global uncertainty signal exists to specialize: T1 harmful class has 9 positives total (2-7 per backend -- unfittable); T2 vote signal is at ceiling (AUC 0.998) globally, leaving no backend-specific headroom for the prediction task. Backend differences that DO matter (vector rescues 9 questions vs kv 4 in the write-rescue falsifier) are carried forward inside alt10, not as a separate policy family.
decision: dead: nothing to specialize; backend heterogeneity subsumed into alt10 analysis
